subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should `run.execution_phase` be supported as a long-lived public diagnostics event for external plugin consumers, with additive future phase values and default-handling expected from consumers?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but accepting a new public payload-union member determines the permanent plugin compatibility and documentation commitment; that policy cannot be inferred safely from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Accept the additive public event
options.body: Confirm the event as supported public diagnostics API and retain the documented additive phase-value contract.

options.title: Keep phases private
options.body: Do not merge the public union addition and keep startup-phase observability behind internal runner or control-UI paths until a broader diagnostics API is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive public event
recommendation.body: Confirm the event as supported public diagnostics API and retain the documented additive phase-value contract.
